Zap Begin Final Four Games Traveling to Fremont for Two Games
By Jon Winkler,
2 hours agoThe Oahe Zap are in the final days of making the push to play for the Independence League Championship next week as the Zap travel to Fremont starting tonight for two games. Oahe is 24-22 on the season and are 12-4 in the last 16 games and control its own destiny to make the Independence League Championship to face the Spearfish Sasquatch. The Zap have to take care of business against the Moo for the next two games in Fremont. Oahe is 5-0 against Fremont this summer, but all five games have been at Hyde Stadium in Pierre which includes a three game sweep of the Moo last week Wednesday through Friday. Oahe will return home to face Hastings on Saturday and Sunday to close the season with the championship series starting next week Tuesday which would be in Pierre for games one and two if the Zap make the series. Spearfish will host games three through five to close the best-of-five series.
